data.name: Divine Descent: Chu-Han
data.detailed_description:
📄 Introduction

This is a light roguelite game with a top-down perspective, similar to a survivor-like game.

In 206 BC, after the fall of the Qin Dynasty, chaos reigned. Xiang Yu enfeoffed the princes, and Liu Bang retreated to Hanzhong, setting the stage for the Chu-Han Contention. However, behind this war that should have been recorded in history, a "time rift" from the future suddenly descended upon the Central Plains battlefield. Dark clouds loomed, heavenly fire fell, and alien shuttles pierced the sky; ancient military formations clashed head-on with unknown technology on the same battlefield.

Players will take on the role of a modern person who accidentally travels back to the Chu-Han period. Originally only seeking a way to return to the future, they discover that their arrival was not accidental: history is being rewritten by a mysterious force, and the war that originally belonged to the Chu and Han sides is gradually evolving into a life-or-death struggle between ancient civilizations and future technology.

In the game, players must navigate the relationships between historical figures such as Liu Bang, Xiang Yu, Han Xin, Zhang Liang, and Fan Zeng, choosing to ally with, betray, assist, or establish their own power.

This game blends historical warfare, time travel, and action-adventure elements. Every choice you make will alter the course of the Chu-Han Contention: Will Xiang Yu be defeated at Gaixia? Will Liu Bang still be able to establish the Han Dynasty? Will foreign technology completely destroy Chinese history? Who is the true enemy: Chu, Han, or the future civilization hidden behind the time rift?

When halberds point to the sky, when war drums drown out thunder, history is no longer just the past.

This time, the Chu-Han Contention is rewritten by you.

🎮 Gameplay

■ Character Selection: 6 characters (currently only 2 in the version), each with their own independent weapon system.

■ Upgrade and Growth: Killing a certain number of enemies will increase weapon damage, range, and projectile count.

■ Resisting Enemy Troops: Enemies are divided into leaders, generals, and soldiers. Defeating a leader will increase the overall enemy attributes.

✅ Game Advantages

■ Low system requirements

■ Short game time (usually ≤20 minutes), with no severe penalties for defeat. Players can easily start a match anytime, anywhere, making it perfect for short bursts of free time.

■ From the faint spark of a single bullet at the start to the instant clearing of a dense horde of monsters, this low-barrier, high-feedback mechanism is an excellent outlet for stress relief.

■ Chinese/English switching

data.short_description: Six (currently only two) young warriors from a future planet accidentally fall through a spacetime rift into the Chu-Han battlefield of the 3rd century BC. Armed with futuristic weaponry, they stage a time-traveling "divine intervention" on the ancient battlefield.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and above
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics card is sufficient (procedural rendering, no 3D load)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics:
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
